title: Organizing Sunday watch, fantasy semis drama, potluck snacks & pool rules
content:
Nina: Who's streaming the game Sunday? thinking of showing the late one in the lounge.
Omar: I'll mirror it on the big screen if we can get HDMI & snacks.
Jules: Fantasy update: I just squeaked into semis by 2 points. Thank you, random fumble.
Ravi: Yo @Jules, hand over your lucky jersey pls
Maya: Quick poll: whos benching a kicker this week? 😂
RefBot: Reminder: Office playoff pool entry deadline is Saturday 11:59pm PST.
Nina: Also if we do snacks, can we do potluck? Label allergens pls.
Omar: I'll grab chips, salsa, and the infamous office hot sauce (beware).
Jules: Stakes: loser has to buy coffee for team for a week ☕
Ravi: I'll accept that punishment.
Maya: Also, 1st time watching with newborn-so I may be a little slower to celebrate :heart:
Nina: Congrats Maya! Well save a spot for you.
Omar: Betting pool side note: No trades after the semis start. Rules in pinned message.
Nina: EOD reminder: send me your team names for the scoreboard display.
